name: Disneyland Plaza Inn World-Famous Fried Chicken Dinner (3-Piece Platter)
whyItWorks: Disneyland's most famous dinner! Three pieces of golden herb-seasoned fried chicken with smooth mashed potatoes, brown poultry gravy, and a soft dinner roll. High in bioavailable protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Fried Chicken Dinner with mashed potatoes and gravy; peel off part of the crispy skin if feeling digestive sensitivity.
watchOuts: Peel away seasoned fried skin during active symptoms
